accepted: pending to claimed to submitted to acknowledged is digest-bound and rebuilt from its transitions
one live lease fences stale worker, stale release and duplicate transition
expired pre-submit claim creates a new attempt without reusing the old fence
jsonl journal replays the same records, fences and pressure counters into a fresh instance
bounded queue sheds only best-effort records with a reason and a counter
denied: crash after claim cannot silently drop critical or terminal notification
expired submitted lease becomes Unknown/reconcile instead of automatic retry
revoked, paused or expired subscription cannot claim, dispatch or acknowledge
queue overflow cannot shed critical, terminal or approval records, and cannot duplicate an action
foreign live claim is never dispatched, released or abandoned by another worker
stale epoch, tampered digest, reverted journal and permissive journal file fail closed
shutdown drain is bounded by deadline and release budget and reports outstanding protected work
worker does not call Broker, channel send or a second agent loop
